item.title: Former IWGP World Champion Tadao Yasuda Passes Away At 62
item.description: Former IWGP World Champion Tadao Yasuda has passed away at the age of 62. According to reports from Tokyo Sports, Yasuda was found dead at his home in Tokyo on Tuesday. Prior to his passing, he had reportedly been working for a security company following his retirement from the ring.
